question: At the Second Battle of Panipat, Bairam Khan defeated _____________.
solution:
Correct answer is** __Hemu__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Second Battle of** Panipat **was fought between the forces of** Samrat Hem Chandra Vikramaditya, popularly called Hemu.**
 
• Hemu was **hindu king** ruling** North India from Delhi, and the army of Akbar, on November 5, 1556.**
 
• It was a decisive victory for **Akbar's generals Khan Zaman I** and Bairam Khan.
 
• A total of three major wars were fought at Panipat, in the years **1526, 1556 and 1761.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​ **The first Battle of Panipat, on 21 April 1526, was fought between the invading forces of **Babur and the Lodi dynasty.**
 
• The Third Battle of Panipat took place on 1**4 January 1761** between** the Maratha Empire and the invading army of the Durrani Afghan Empire. **
